name: Goal command
description: Captures a per-thread goal, keeps it in front of the agent, and can gate work that leaves the thread's directory.

actions.name: goal
actions.title: Set or clear the thread goal
actions.description: Arms the thread: the next message becomes its goal. Run it again to clear the goal.

settings.label: Confine file changes
settings.description: While a goal is active, deny file changes outside the thread's working directory when the provider asks for approval.

settings.label: Allowed command prefixes
settings.description: One prefix per line. While a goal is active, deny commands that match none of them when the provider asks for approval. Empty lets commands through. Prefixes are blunt: allowing `git` also allows `git push --force`.
